# TerrainUsers

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/physics/terrain_colliders.h`](../../../src/physics/terrain_colliders.h) · Scene / prefab name: `null` · Described in `data/core.json`

Bodies that are no RigidBody and need the terrain under them (a ragdoll's segments)

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `bodies` | `std::vector<JPH::BodyID>` | the segments |

## Notes

World context, set by the agent factories when the world has TerrainColliders, read by WorldTerrain.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: WorldTerrain. Written by: AgentFactory, AnimalFactory. Created by: AnimalFactory. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AgentFactory](../systems/AgentFactory.md) | system | World | **write** | init | The segment bodies, for WorldTerrain to build colliders around. |
| [AnimalFactory](../systems/AnimalFactory.md) | system | World | **write+create** | init | The ragdoll's bodies, so WorldTerrain builds colliders under them. |
| [WorldTerrain](../systems/WorldTerrain.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | ragdoll segments needing ground (one box around them) |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AgentFactory](../systems/AgentFactory.md)**
  - Reads resources/<body> and resources/<params> and hashes them (SHA-256); throws AssetError on a malformed file.
  - Creates 16 Jolt bodies and, for a dynamic walker, 15 swing-twist constraints with motors; removes them at finish.
  - Moves the static Ground bodies at every episode start (slope) and sets the segments' poses, velocities and mass properties.
  - Creates the drawn shape entities when draw is set; they live as long as the world.
  - Logs errors without a HumanBotSpawn entity or with WalkRoutes but no ground field, a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[AnimalFactory](../systems/AnimalFactory.md)**
  - Reads the body file, the params file and the ranges file (params and ranges hashed with SHA-256); throws AssetError when one is missing.
  - Creates the ragdoll's Jolt bodies and constraints; destroys them in finish.
  - Creates one entity per segment shape when draw is set.
  - Logs an error without an AnimalSpawn, a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.
- **[WorldTerrain](../systems/WorldTerrain.md)**
  - Creates and destroys static Jolt MeshShape bodies in the world's PhysicsWorld, in sorted cell order.
  - CPU marching cubes and FastNoise2 sampling on the world's thread.
  - Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin in preinit; log warning on a refused mesh.
